metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the three tellings, the three gifts, and the bench.

yesterday: Susanna's order: about two in the afternoon, wind south-west, the bell, the Guild Pits, twenty houses and barns by dark, and every person safe.
Judith's widow stayed for the hens. The bailiff's man shouted orders at the wind. Hamnet got to the top of the street, Richard turned him back, and the bent nail is his.
The fables have woodcuts, and Judith had the ballad at one hearing. The H has been in Plutarch, and Master Field is the one who calls him dear.
You yielded on whom. She had the queen right before you told her. The queen steps into the shadow of the trees.
Anne asked three weeks. You said till the eighteenth.
